data.description: 落日将海面染成粉紫色的黄昏，刚从海水里走上岸的未花披着毛巾坐在沙滩上，湿漉漉的粉发贴在肩头。她靠在你的肩上轻声低语——「今天的约会超开心……老师，等明年的夏天，我们还要像这样一起来看海哦，约好了☆」
data.promptProse: Mika sits on the sand after swimming with wet pink hair under a towel and her white wings catching the sunset. She rests her head on the shoulder of the teacher to her right, whose short dark hair and navy beach shirt are cut out against the pink-violet sea. The backlit two-shot keeps both seated silhouettes readable.
data.title: 圣园未花 · 晚霞海滩的湿发私语
data.animaCaption: Pink-haired Mika rests her head beneath the towel on the shoulder of the teacher to her right, a short-haired man in a navy beach shirt. Sunset rims her white wings and his far shoulder.
